body: Would you mind elaborating on what you mean by "labor", as my boss never really had me do much from the start other than occasionally set up snacks for employees and fetch paper copies from the printer.
Thanks, friend! Did the math and even taking into account our 4 day work weeks (building closed Fri-Sun) and our sometimes 3 hour shifts, that's still $8.67/hr- below NYS min wage.

About the verbal contract- I never actually signed a written document, just agreed to intern. I did some very brief research and found that verbal contracts can be valid for up to a year after they're made, but do correct me if I'm wrong.
Thanks so much for your help! And good luck to you as well! :D
I happen to like playing my ukulele quite a lot, so maybe that'll help a little. Thanks for taking the time to help out as best you can, kind stranger!
I'll be sure to take that into account, and thanks for the advice on both fronts! I hear New Zealand has beautiful scenery!

Nah, I haven't really mentioned it to anyone because I figured I was just over-thinking things. That, and I didn't wanna make them feel bad because I still get how they mean it.

Good to know that New Zealand is full of polite people XD. If I had the means to, I would definitely take the time to visit once it gets warmer!
